no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: LianBio announced wind-down of operations in late 2023 / early 2024; the company terminated remaining licenses (mavacamten with Bristol-Myers Squibb, infigratinib with BridgeBio, BBP-398 with Navire/BridgeBio, lotilaner/TP-03 with Tarsus) and returned rights to licensors. Latest 10-K on file is FY2022 (filed 2023-03-28). All sponsored P1-P3 trials in CT.gov are COMPLETED, TERMINATED, or UNKNOWN status. No active proprietary clinical-stage pipeline remains.

10k.note: Latest available; LianBio became delinquent / wound down after this filing.
